source: lab (captured; background replaced by a uniform green gradient with SAM2 - watermark 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' bottom-right, x 1030-1280, y 690-720)
time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame 0 at t = 0; container pts verified uniform (1/24 s steps)

camera.motion: static (background difference between consecutive frames < 0.5 grey levels; background is a synthetic replacement, so no real scene features remain)

intrinsics_lab.note: from benchmark convention f = 0.5959 x width

camera.perspective_cues: No ground plane, horizon or vanishing points visible (background replaced). Only cue: ball apparent diameter shrinks from ~136 px (held, frame 0-27) to ~94-100 px at the bounce (frame 37-38), and grows back to ~110 px at the rebound apex (frame 46): the ball falls AWAY from the camera (camera looks down/forward at the floor).

objects.name: basketball
objects.description: orange basketball with black seams; the only object in the video. Held still (holder's hand removed by segmentation, leaving a cut-out 'bite' in the lower part of the ball), released, falls, bounces once off the (invisible) floor, rises to an apex and starts falling again.
objects.partially_cut_frames: 0-31 (hand-removal mask cuts the lower part; frames 28-31 the ball is split into 2-3 pieces)
objects.reference_point: centre of a circle fitted to the outer ball contour (cx_fit, cy_fit) - the visible ball centre, robust to the cut-out

depth_in_ball_diameters.column: Z_per_D / R_per_D (pinhole with f = 762.8 px; multiply by true diameter, or rescale with given depth_info)

static_objects: none visible (background fully replaced; floor, holder and room are not visible). The floor is only implied by the bounce.

events.event: ball held nearly still (slight drift up ~7 px between frames 0 and 26)
release / start of fall (last highest point is frame 26; frame 27 already 3.8 px lower; frame 28 +12 px)
lowest image point / bounce off the floor (ball centre y = 657 px, bottom edge y = 713)
events.uncertainty: contact between frames 36 and 38; frame 37 is the lowest sample

events.event: rebound apex (minimum y = 481.3 px, max apparent size ~110 px)

anomalies: Frame step 35->36 moves 114 px in y while neighbouring steps are ~57 px: probably a dropped camera frame in the capture (pts are uniform in the file). Treat per-frame speeds around frame 36 with caution.
Motion blur frames 33-37: mask elongated vertically; diam_px_best uses bbox width there.
